# vendor/stb

`stb_image.h`, **unmodified**, from Sean Barrett's stb single-file libraries.

- Version: v2.30 (as stated in the file's header)
- Upstream: <https://github.com/nothings/stb> (file `stb_image.h`)
- Licence: public domain, or MIT, at the user's choice (stated at the end of the file)
- SHA-256: `594c2fe35d49488b4382dbfaec8f98366defca819d916ac95becf3e75f4200b3`

Used only by `tools/png2art/png2art.c`, a host tool, to read PNG and GIF files.
Nothing from here is linked into the kernel, the DOS or any `.PRG`.
